UnBe. Women & Men Discovery Set 6x2 ML
body_html:
No Series Women & Men Discovery Set – 6 x 2 ml

The No Series Women’s Discovery Set brings together four of the most popular fragrances in exclusive 2 ml sample sizes. It’s the perfect choice for those who want to experience the scents before committing to a full-size purchase.

Each vial is carefully crafted to reflect the true character of the fragrance, allowing you to explore different scents in your daily routine.

Set Includes:

  • No Regrets Women’s Perfume EDP (2 ml)
  • No Tears Women’s Perfume EDP (2 ml)
  • No Filter Women’s Perfume EDP (2 ml)
  • No Drama Women’s Perfume EDP (2 ml)
  • No Rules Men’s Perfume EDP (2 ml)
  • No Excuse Men’s Perfume EDP (2 ml)

Key Features:

  • Practical 2 ml trial-size bottles
  • Ideal for testing before purchasing the full size
  • Perfect for daily use and on-the-go carry
  • Opportunity to explore different fragrance profiles
  • EDP concentration that reflects the original formula
